title: TESSERA embeddings
description: Annual 10 m, 128-dimensional per-pixel embeddings from the TESSERA model (University of Cambridge), which encodes a full year of Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 observations per pixel. Wall-to-wall global for land, served as tiles on a 0.1-degree grid and as Zarr/Icechunk stores; suited to crop, habitat and land cover mapping from few labels.

review: License: the producer's README says CC0 for embeddings and weights; the AWS Open Data registry lists CC-BY-SA. Recorded the producer's statement.
Year coverage: README says global for 2024 and 2017-2025 for regions such as the US and Europe, back-filling; AWS registry and geotessera say 2017-2025.

providers.name: University of Cambridge, Energy and Environment Group

emb:quantization_method: int8 values with separate float32 scales (geotessera.dequantize_embedding); Zarr API returns float32
processing:lineage: A full year of Sentinel-2 L2A (10 bands) and Sentinel-1 RTC (VV, VH, ascending and descending) stacked along time per pixel; v1.1 uses every valid observation instead of 40 sampled timesteps. Tiles on a 0.1 x 0.1 degree grid (about 11 km).
temporal_coverage_note: Global for 2024; other years 2017-2025 complete only in some regions (e.g. US, Europe), back-filling year by year.

zarr.title: TESSERA v1.1 Icechunk store (AWS Open Data)

access_requirements: open HTTP/S3, no account; v2 embeddings only on request
